calibrated_reliability.note: In-sample over the settled ledger (the isotonic transform is fit on these same outcomes); held-out 70/30 validation is in recalibration_map.json. p_predicted = raw model prob (kept untouched for the learning loop); p_calibrated = honest prob stamped per pick. Lower ECE/Brier on the calibrated column = the displayed % is truer.

curated.definition: Featured/recommended plays only -- Lock of the Day, Top 25, Whale, Sharp, Consensus (hit), Under Alerts, POD. Excludes the experimental prop feeds, which are tracked to train the model, not bet.

price_corrections.note: MLB moneylines recorded when no book price was loaded had been graded at a placeholder -110. Each was re-priced at the real DraftKings pre-game line (from the snapshot history), or voided when no real line exists.

The same gap on the away side (+100) and the total (8.5), plus Play-of-the-Day moneylines recorded at in-play Bovada prices (10/13 TBR at +940 when DraftKings' pre-game line was -137). Every MLB moneyline is now graded at the DraftKings pre-game line; Play-of-the-Day totals whose 8.5 line DraftKings never posted were voided -- a bet on a line that did not exist has no honest result.

price_corrections.label: totals
price_corrections.note: Top 25 and the Under Alerts read the same placeholder 8.5 total, and some totals were taken from in-play boards. Every settled MLB total was checked against the lines books posted before first pitch: picks on a line no book posted pre-game were voided (they had gone 30-17 -- e.g. UNDER 8.5 when the real total was 6.5), and picks on DraftKings' line are now graded at its real over/under juice instead of a flat -110.

restatement.note: The headline became ALL-TIME on 2026-10-23. 5,946 settled picks that the old tail-cut eviction had destroyed (May-June 2026, the 07-06 erosion and the run-up to 09-03) were rebuilt from git history at each pick's final state, with today's duplicate-wager rule re-applied, and folded back in. They are mostly the raw May-June MLB prop firehose (2,961-2,983, -1,256.9u), so the firehose ROI fell; the curated record changed by the curated picks among them. Before this date the published numbers covered the working window only -- working_ledger_only keeps that basis.

nfl_props_by_model.note: NFL props are judged from 10/23 forward: the simulator's form rule changed, so earlier picks are a different model. They stay on the record as their own line and never feed a family verdict.

note: Unified pick ledger -- records every pick the model surfaces (top_25 board, whales, consensus, unders, sharp action, locks, POD) and settles each against actual outcomes. Per-source W-L feeds back into calibration so the model learns which modules are reliable. THIS is the training signal.
